title: 5 Agent Skill Design Patterns Every ADK Developer Should Know
author: @GoogleCloudTech (amplifying @Saboo_Shubham_ and @lavinigam)

discoveries.name: Tool Wrapper Pattern
discoveries.description: Package library docs/API references as reusable agent context — instant expertise on any library. Simplest skill pattern.
discoveries.action: Apply to our MCP tool skills — wrap each tool's documentation as a skill that agents load on demand

discoveries.name: Generator Pattern
discoveries.description: Produce structured documents from reusable templates. Can compose with Inversion to gather variables first.
discoveries.action: Formalize our existing template-based code generation as Generator skills

discoveries.name: Reviewer Pattern
discoveries.description: Score code/content against severity-organized checklists. Embeddable as Pipeline checkpoint.
discoveries.action: Map to our multi-model review quality gate — structure review prompts as severity-scored checklists

discoveries.name: Inversion Pattern
discoveries.description: Agent interviews user before acting. Flips control from 'guess and act' to 'ask first, then act'.
discoveries.action: Apply to roadblock recovery — agents should gather context before attempting fixes

discoveries.name: Pipeline Pattern
discoveries.description: Strict sequential workflow with checkpoints. Composes with Reviewer and other patterns.
discoveries.action: Our orchestrator loop is already a Pipeline — formalize as a named skill pattern

discoveries.name: Progressive Disclosure via SkillToolset
discoveries.description: ADK's SkillToolset loads skill context only when triggered, not upfront. Agents only spend tokens on patterns needed at runtime.
discoveries.action: Aligns with context-is-zero-sum principle — adopt progressive skill loading in our agent prompts

discoveries.name: Patterns Compose
discoveries.description: The five patterns are combinable: Pipeline+Reviewer, Generator+Inversion, etc. Building blocks, not rigid templates.

deep_dive_candidates.reason: Official ADK Skills docs — L1/L2/L3 structure, SkillToolset API
